prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1020; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement today. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but I understand you need it for the file. Go ahead and note that I am the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: Understood. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was in Sugar Land, Texas, at an intersection with a green light for the turn. I was making a left turn across the oncoming lanes when the other car came through.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I looked before I started the turn, but the oncoming car was coming pretty fast and I didn't see it until it was almost on me. I braked as hard as I could.

Q: What happened next?

A: The front of the other car hit the driver's side of mine. My airbag went off and my car spun a little before it stopped.

Q: Were you taken for medical care?

A: An ambulance came and took me to the emergency room. They checked me over and said my right knee was badly bruised and possibly sprained. It's swollen and I can barely bend it.

Q: Are you still receiving treatment for the knee?

A: Yes, I have an appointment with an orthopedic doctor next week. I've been using crutches and icing it at home.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the collision?

A: Only that I was following the traffic signal and I believe the other driver was speeding. That's all I can say for now.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
